{"command": "gh pr create --base main --head feat/search --title "feat(search): persistent engineering memory — FTS5 search over captured traces" --body "## What

A local full-text search index over everything the proxy captures — prompts, responses, tool calls, file edits, shell commands, errors — exposed as REST + MCP tools + CLI + a dashboard Search tab. The agent-facing goal: ask \"have we solved anything similar before?\" instead of re-exploring the repo.

## Architecture

\`\`\`
Parse (off-hot) → Analyze / Recommend / Search index (off-hot)
\`\`\`

- **Separate \`search.sqlite\`** (WAL) — indexing never contends with the hot-path store; the index is disposable and rebuilt from raw NDJSON traces (which stay authoritative). Schema version bump (PRAGMA user_version) triggers automatic drop + rebuild.
- **\`src/search/extract.ts\`** — pure trace→chunk extraction for Anthropic / OpenAI / Bedrock / Ollama formats; line-aligned splitting (4KB, max 64 parts); stable chunk uids + content hashes (embeddings can attach in v2 without reindexing).
- **\`src/search/search-store.ts\`** — external-content FTS5 kept in sync by triggers; BM25 ranking; injection-safe MATCH builder; facets + paged queries.
- **\`src/search/indexer.ts\`** — idempotent (keyed by request_id; repeated history deduped per session by content hash), batch-bounded, runs in the serve tick and via \`aap index\`.

## Surfaces

- REST: \`GET /search\` (q, kind, provider, project, tool, file, session, errors, since/until, limit/offset → hits + total), \`/search/facets\`, \`/search/status\`, \`/search/chunks/:uid\`
- MCP: \`search_history\`, \`search_edits\`, \`search_errors\`, \`find_previous_fix\`, \`recall_session\` (session-grouped snippets — never raw transcripts), \`search_status\`
- CLI: \`aap index [--all]\`, \`aap search <query> [filters]\`
- UI: Search tab — provider/project/tool/kind dropdowns (facet-fed), errors-only, pagination with deep-linkable \`?page=N\`
- Config: \`[search] enabled / intervalMs / batchSize\`

## Verified

- 300 tests (38 new: extraction per provider, FTS store, idempotent indexer, schema-version rebuild, facets/paging)
- Quality gate green: typecheck → lint → format:check → test → build
- Dogfooded on real data: 3,373 requests → 20,280 chunks, 0 failures; live tick indexes new requests within ~5s

## Out of scope (deliberate)

- Embeddings / semantic similarity (v2 — chunk schema ready)
- LLM knowledge extraction
- Importing agent-native transcripts for non-proxied sessions (next branch)" 2>&1 | tail -2", "timeout": 60000, "workdir": "/Users/demo/Projects/aitools/ai-agent-profiler-feat-search"}

## What

\`aap import\` indexes conversations recorded by the agents themselves into the same search index, covering sessions that never went through the proxy (or predate it).

- **Claude Code**: \`~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl\` via the existing active-path reconstruction in \`analyze/claude-transcript\` (extended additively with sessionId/cwd/timestamp/model). Same session id as proxied traffic → content dedupes via the existing \`(session_id, content_hash)\` unique index.
- **opencode**: reads \`~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db\` (readonly). text/reasoning/tool parts → chunks with provider/model. Sessions overlapping an already-proxied aap session (same directory + intersecting time window) are skipped; \`--include-proxied\` forces.
- **Session titles** become a new \`title\` chunk kind — high-signal recall anchors.
- **Idempotent & incremental**: one synthetic request per message (\`cc:<uuid>\` / \`oc:<msg-id>\`) in \`index_state\`; re-runs only touch new messages. Agent files are never modified.

## Validation on real data

- 270 Claude messages + 19,213 opencode messages from 315 sessions (92 proxied correctly skipped) → 62,657 chunks
- The motivating case — a July 10 'jobs' session invisible to the proxy — now surfaces as the top hit: \`aap search james mace --kind title\` → *London staff role via James Mace (visa)*
- Searchable history now reaches back to May 30, pre-dating the profiler

## Gates

309 tests (9 new), typecheck / lint / format:check / build green." 2>&1 | tail -1", "timeout": 120000, "workdir": "/Users/demo/Projects/aitools/ai-agent-profiler-feat-transcript-import"}

## Engineering memory (search) — shipped on `feat/search` (PR #17)

**Shipped:** FTS5 index (`search.sqlite`, separate from the hot-path store, rebuildable
from raw traces; schema version bump = automatic drop + rebuild). Chunk extraction for
all provider formats with per-session content-hash dedup. Surfaces: REST (`/search`,
`/search/facets`, `/search/status`), MCP (`search_history`, `search_edits`,
`search_errors`, `find_previous_fix`, `recall_session`), CLI (`aap index`, `aap search`,
`aap import`), UI Search tab (provider/project/tool/kind filters, pagination).
`aap import` fills non-proxied gaps from Claude Code `~/.claude/projects` and opencode's
local DB; session titles indexed as `title` chunks.

### Next (in order)

1. **Dogfood before building more.** Use the MCP tools from real sessions
   (`recall_session` / `search_history` at task start). Success = the agent skips
   re-exploration; collect queries that MISS to decide whether embeddings are needed.
   The MCP tools have not yet been exercised by a real agent — do this first.
2. **Post-review polish** (small, after #17 merges):
   - Auto-import transcripts on a serve tick (`[search] importTranscripts`, default off;
     currently manual `aap import`).
   - `aap index --prune` — drop chunks orphaned by out-of-band session/trace deletion.
   - Ranking: boost `title` and `compact` (summary) chunks in `recall_session`;
     consider down-weighting bulky `tool_result` chunks.
   - UI: facet/badge for source (`proxy` vs `claude-import` vs `opencode-import`).
3. **Embeddings (v2)** — only if dogfooding shows lexical misses on conceptual queries
   ("socket binding conflict" → "ZMQ port race"). Plan: `sqlite-vec` + local Ollama
   embedding model (config-driven, off by default); chunk table already has stable
   `chunk_uid`s to attach vectors without reindexing; hybrid rank = BM25 + cosine.
4. **Knowledge extraction (v3, deferred)** — LLM-distilled durable facts ("chose
   advisory locks because…") in a `facts` table linked to sessions. Opt-in, token cost,
   needs prompt design. Revisit once months of history accumulate.

### Known gaps / limitations to track

- opencode import skips sessions overlapping a proxied session (same cwd + time window);
  `--include-proxied` forces but can duplicate content across different session ids.
- Pre-DB opencode versions (JSON-file storage) are not imported.
- Only Claude Code + opencode transcripts covered; other agents (e.g. Codex CLI) are not.
- `recall_session(commit=...)` from the original vision is unimplemented — would need
  commit-hash extraction from `git commit` shell commands into chunk metadata.
- Search covers proxied traffic + imported transcripts only; anything else never
  captured is invisible (by design — raw data stays authoritative).

---", "oldString": "---"}
